## Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between the Individual and Team license?

The Individual license is for a single user and cannot be shared. The Team license includes centralized billing, shared interception rules, and priority support for multiple seats.

Does NetworkSpy support HTTPS interception?

Yes, NetworkSpy supports full HTTPS interception. It automatically installs a root certificate to decrypt traffic on your local machine.

Can I use NetworkSpy on multiple devices?

An Individual license allows you to use NetworkSpy on only 1 device. Team licenses are per-seat.

Is NetworkSpy free?

Yes, NetworkSpy is free to use with core features! You can download and use it forever without paying. Advanced features like the Custom Viewer Builder require a paid plan.

How does the Lifetime license work?

The Lifetime license is a one-time purchase that gives you access to the current version and all minor updates forever. Major version upgrades may require a discounted upgrade fee.

Can NetworkSpy inspect traffic from physical mobile devices?

Yes, you can configure your physical iOS or Android device to use NetworkSpy as a proxy to inspect its traffic.

Does NetworkSpy work with gRPC and WebSockets?

Yes, NetworkSpy has first-class support for both gRPC (including Protobuf decoding) and WebSockets with real-time message streaming.

What happens after my subscription ends?

If you are on a subscription plan and cancel, you will lose access to the app at the end of your billing period unless you purchase a Lifetime license.

Do you offer refunds?

Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee if you are not satisfied with NetworkSpy.

How does NetworkSpy compare to Wireshark or Charles Proxy?

While Wireshark is great for low-level packet analysis, NetworkSpy is designed specifically for application-level HTTP/HTTPS debugging. Compared to Charles, NetworkSpy offers a more modern UI, better support for streaming/SSE, and built-in AI debugging features.

items.snippet:
Privacy Policy | NetworkSpy

# Privacy Policy

Last Updated: April 16, 2026

## 1. Information We Collect

At NetworkSpy, we prioritize your privacy. We collect the following information:

- Email Address: Used for license delivery and account management.
- License Keys: Associated with your email to validate your access.
- Device Identifiers: Anonymous identifiers used solely to prevent license abuse and manage your device limit.

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information for:

- Validating your license and granting access to the Software.
- Providing technical support and updates.
- Enforcing our Terms of Service (device limits).

Note: We do NOT collect or monitor the network traffic you inspect with NetworkSpy. All traffic data remains local to your machine.

## 3. Third-Party Services

We use Polar.sh as our payment processor. They handle your payment details (credit card information) according to their own privacy policy. We do not store your financial information.

## 4. Cookies

We use minimal cookies for administrative purposes (e.g., maintaining your admin session) and for essential site functionality. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.

## 5. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.

## 6. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or request the deletion of your personal information (email address and license data). Please contact us for such requests.

## 7. Changes to This Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.
